notes.title: Welcome to your encrypted knowledge vault
notes.summary: A starting point for turning scattered learning into a private, searchable personal system.
content: Use this space for reusable frameworks, lessons learned, reading notes, decision patterns, and ideas that are useful to your future self.

Write knowledge in private/knowledge.json, run the local encryption tool, and publish only vault-data.js. The public file contains ciphertext, salt, and an initialization vector—not the plaintext notes or password.

Keep credentials, recovery codes, client-confidential data, identity documents, and other high-impact secrets outside this static vault. Those belong in a dedicated password manager or a properly authenticated private service.
